working_features: Runs in a REPL loop accepting text commands
User can add a task with a title and optional priority via 'add' command
User can list all tasks showing ID, title, priority, status, and creation date
User can mark a task as complete by its ID with 'done' command
User can delete a task by its ID with 'delete' command
User can filter tasks by status with 'list active' and 'list done'
User can sort tasks by priority or date with 'list --sort priority' and 'list --sort date'
User can search tasks by keyword with 'search' command
Tasks are saved to a JSON file automatically after every change
Tasks are loaded from the JSON file on startup if it exists
Handles invalid commands and task IDs gracefully with helpful error messages
User can type 'help' to see available commands
User can type 'quit' or 'exit' to stop the program

final_review.suggestions: Consider adding a specific error message when the --sort flag is used without an argument (e.g., 'list --sort'). Currently it silently ignores the flag. Using shlex to support quoted titles (e.g., 'add "Buy milk"') would also improve the user experience.
